description: This file defines the abstract class PDFEngine within the SuiteCRM\PDF namespace, serving as a base for PDF rendering implementations. It includes abstract methods related to writing HTML content, styling, page management, and output configuration for PDF generation.

classes.name: PDFEngine
classes.description: An abstract base class for PDF generation engines, defining core methods to be implemented for rendering PDFs in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: writeHTML
methods.description: Abstract method to write HTML content into the PDF.

methods.name: writeFooter
methods.description: Abstract method to write footer HTML or array into the PDF.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Abstract method to write header HTML or array into the PDF.

methods.name: addCSS
methods.description: Abstract method to add CSS styles to the PDF.

methods.name: writeBlankPage
methods.description: Abstract method to insert a blank page into the PDF.

methods.name: outputPDF
methods.description: Abstract method to output the generated PDF with specified name and destination.

methods.name: configurePDF
methods.description: Abstract method to configure PDF options based on provided array.
